notes.title: Version 1.1 Avabled Now!
notes.content:
Version 1.1 is now available.
With Halloween approaching, pumpkins have appeared in the secret realm. Collect them to make a pumpkin mask. After updating to version 1.1, you will have a chance to obtain pumpkins in the secret realm until Halloween ends.

Update content: 
[list] 
[*] [b]Implemented[/b]
Level: Star area 5~10 has been opened.
Halloween rewards and skin have been added.
[*] [b]Fix[/b]
Fixed the issue of skin showing.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0 Avabled Now!
notes.content:
Version 1.0 has been released, and now you can enjoy the complete game content. 
In the future, new levels and other game content will be added periodically.

Update content: 
[list] 
[*] [b]Implemented[/b]
[olist]
[*] Level: Opened up the star area. You can go to the starry sky area after clearing the ruins, volcano, and snowfield areas. 
[*] After obtaining memory fragments, you can watch past memories related to the area and view acquired memories in the main menu. 
[*] Added a space suit appearance for O. Go synthesize it!
[/olist]
[/list]

tags.feature: - Level: Opened up the star area. You can go to the starry sky area after clearing the ruins, volcano, and snowfield areas.
- After obtaining memory fragments, you can watch past memories related to the area and view acquired memories in the main menu.
- Added a space suit appearance for O. Go synthesize it!

notes.title: Version 0.9 Avabled Now!
notes.content:
Version 0.9 has been released, with new content:

[list]
[*] [b]Implement[/b]	
	Level: Snow Mountain Area 16-30 has been opened. Now all levels in the common adventure area have been opened. Enjoy your adventure!
[*] [b]Adjust[/b]	
[olist]
[*] 	The 15th level of snow mountain area can now obtain memory fragments and has corresponding achievements.
[*] 	Some of the snow mountain area level BGM has been changed.

[/olist]
[/list]

notes.title: Mother's Day event is here!
notes.content:
Mother’s Day is here again and carnations have appeared in the secret realm. You can make a beautiful flower wreath just by collecting them.
After updating to version 0.8.1, you have the chance to obtain carnations in the secret realm until the next version update.

[list]
[*] [b]Implement[/b]
	Mother’s Day limited rewards and skin have been added.
[*] [b]Fix[/b]
[olist]
[*] The gamepad can now operate the item/synthesis window normally.
[*] Invalid items will not appear in the item/synthesis window.
[/olist]
[/list]

tags.feature: Mother’s Day limited rewards and skin have been added.

tags.bug: The gamepad can now operate the item/synthesis window normally.
Invalid items will not appear in the item/synthesis window.

notes.title: Version 0.8 Avabled Now!
notes.content:
Version 0.8 has been released, with new content:
[list]
[*] [b]Implement[/b]
[olist]
[*] Skin system has been implemented. You can now obtain new skins through synthesis. Click O on the homepage to change your skin. 
This version releases 7 skins, and more will be gradually released later.
[*] New level: Snow mountain area levels 6-15 are now open.
[*] Added several level rewards.
[/olist]
[*] [b]Known issues[/b]
[olist]
[*] Sometimes entering the next level will fail and you can only restart the game.
[*] When an item/appearance is selected, there may be an uncovered situation.
[*] When using the gamepad to open the props/synthesis interface, the props cannot be selected correctly, you must use the mouse to operate.
[/olist]
[/list]
Developer’s note: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom will be released next week, so updates will be slower in the future.

tags.feature: Skin system has been implemented. You can now obtain new skins through synthesis. Click O on the homepage to change your skin.
New level: Snow mountain area levels 6-15 are now open.

tags.bug: Sometimes entering the next level will fail and you can only restart the game.
When an item/appearance is selected, there may be an uncovered situation.
When using the gamepad to open the props/synthesis interface, the props cannot be selected correctly, you must use the mouse to operate.

notes.title: Version 0.7.2 Avabled Now!
notes.content:
Version 0.7.2 has been released, with new content:

[list]
[*] [b]Implement[/b]

[*] Now you can challenge the 4th and 5th levels in the snow mountain area!

notes.title: Version 0.7.0 Avabled Now!
notes.content:
Version 0.7.0 has been released, with new content:

[list]
[*] [b]Install[/b]
  All the levels in the volcano area have been implemented, and now you can challenge all the levels in the volcano area! (However, some effects are not perfect)
[*] [b]Resource Replacement[/b]
  With the replacement of some music and sound effects, the smell of canned food is reduced! Thanks for  TPOP Studio!
[*] [b]The mechanism has been modified[/b]
Now the energy will return to 0 when injured, which is more challenging!
[*] [b]Fix[/b]
[olist]
[*] The right joystick of the gamepad can now adjust the launch force normally
[*] Correct some level configurations
[/olist]
[*] [b]Known issues[/b]
Now achievements will be inexplicably fully opened, this is not what I want...but you can open it > <
[/list]
